plugin.name: Local scripts
plugin.description: Save bash scripts with :name parameters, a timeout and a line limit, run them on this Mac and export them all as .sh files.
field.exportFolder.hint: “Export all” writes every script here as an executable <name>.sh.
note.noFolder: To export the scripts as .sh files, grant this plugin a folder on its plugin page.
error.empty: There is no script to run.
error.badTimeout: The timeout must be a whole number of seconds from 1 to {max}.
error.badMaxLines: The line limit must be a whole number from 1 to {max}.
error.noFolder: No folder is granted to this plugin. Grant one on its plugin page, then export again.
error.pickFolder: Choose the folder to export to.
error.folderGone: That folder is no longer granted to this plugin.
error.nothingToExport: There are no saved scripts to export.
error.param.nul: The value of “{name}” contains a NUL character.
error.param.tooLong: The value of “{name}” is longer than {max} characters.
error.param.number: The value of “{name}” must be a number.
error.param.enum: The value of “{name}” is not one of its choices.
error.template: Parameters cannot be used safely in this command: {why}. Remove the :name parameters there or simplify the shell text.
template.arith: arithmetic that is not closed as bash would
template.openHeredoc: a here-document whose end line is missing
template.heredoc: a here-document body that cannot be read
error.param.unsafe: The value of “{name}” looks like an array index with a command in it ([…$(…)…]); it is refused.
error.param.arith: “{name}” is used in arithmetic, so its value must be a whole number.
field.exportConflict.hint: Empty: stop before writing anything when a .sh of the same name is already there.
error.exists: These files already exist: {files}. Choose what to do in “If a file exists”, then export again.
error.badConflict: That choice for an existing file is not known.
